Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor activation with Redwood. We have a new buyer relationship with Terrafirma Logistics and procurement needs a few items to create the vendor record and enable POs/ACH. Can you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday (11/24) if possible?

Required fields (we can accept documents as PDFs):
- Legal entity name and any DBA
- Legal address (registered/incorporation address)
- Tax ID / EIN (documented on W-9 or W-8)
- Remit-to address (where PO invoices should be sent)
- Preferred payment method (ACH or wire)
- If ACH: routing number + account number (or bank verification letter)
- If wire: beneficiary name, bank name, SWIFT/BIC, ABA/IBAN, account number
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone)
- PO billing email (for invoice submission)
- Copy of W-9 (US vendors) or W-8 (non-US)
- If applicable: VAT/GST registration number and country

I attached a Buyer Intake form and a bank-details template to make this easier. If any of the items above are not available yet, please send whatever you can and flag gaps.

Also let me know if Terrafirma requires a vendor agreement signature before we enable ACH or process first payment. Finance (cc'd) will validate docs and confirm activation timelines.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
